zh: 企业与生产基地
河源市台衡顶尖称重设备有限公司成立于2014年7月，公司位于河源市江东新区恒泰科技园，制造基地位于东莞市大岭山镇。采购方安排现场交流时，可先按商务洽谈或车间考察确认到访地址。
en: Company and manufacturing base

Founded in July 2014, Heyuan Taiheng Top Weighing Equipment Co., Ltd. is based in Hengtai Technology Park in Heyuan. Its manufacturing base is in Dalingshan, Dongguan. Confirm the appropriate address when arranging a business meeting or workshop visit.

zh: 从称重任务开始选型
公路车辆的整车称重、输送带上的连续计量和容器内物料的库存计量，所需的承载结构和数据记录方式各不相同。询价时先说明要称什么、在哪里称，以及记录交给谁使用。
en: Define the weighing task

A truck crossing a yard, material travelling on a belt and material stored in a vessel require different load-bearing structures and records. Describe the load, the location and who needs the result before specifying equipment.

zh: 准备一份现场简报
提供车辆照片、平面图、可用尺寸和预计最高载荷。若属于旧秤改造，还应提供原仪表型号、基础照片和现有称重票样，以便讨论可以沿用的部分。
en: Prepare a site brief

Send vehicle photographs, a site plan, available dimensions and the highest expected load. For a retrofit, include the existing indicator model, foundation photographs and a sample ticket so the team can assess what may be retained.

zh: 沿着秤台结构看车间
画册展示厂区、秤台加工和焊接车间。考察分体秤台时，可带上车辆轴距和安装图，对照观察模块连接、检修空间和传感器支承位置。
en: Inspect the deck assembly

The brochure shows the grounds, fabrication area and welding workshop. Bring vehicle wheelbase information and an installation drawing to review module joints, service clearances and load cell supports.

zh: 运输条件如何影响分段
现场入口宽度、转弯半径、卸货位置和起吊条件会影响秤台分段及到场顺序。提前标在场地图上，有助于制造端和安装端核对交接条件。
en: Plan delivery and lifting

Gate width, turning space, unloading position and lifting access affect how deck sections reach their final positions. Mark these constraints on the site plan before agreeing section sizes and the delivery sequence.

zh: 交付前核对接口
按双方确认的图纸逐项核对秤台外形、模块编号、仪表电缆出口和接线箱位置，记录现场安装需要使用的图纸版本。
en: Check interfaces before delivery
Use the agreed drawing to check deck dimensions, module identifiers, cable exits and junction box locations. Record the drawing revision that the installation team will use.

zh: 识别证书主体
先看画册图片上的企业全称、发证机构与证书编号，再和采购合同主体对照。若项目由制造方、销售方和安装方共同参与，应分别确认各自承担的工作。
en: Identify the certificate holder

Compare the legal name, issuing body and certificate number shown in the brochure with the proposed contracting party. Where manufacturing, sales and installation involve different parties, record each party’s role.

zh: 核对范围和日期
按项目要求逐份查看适用业务、场所及有效期。画册是出版时的资料，招标或验收需要现行文件时，应向企业索取清晰的最新版本。
en: Check scope and dates

Review the activity, location and validity period covered by each document. A brochure records information at publication. Request a current, legible copy when preparing tender or acceptance documents.

zh: 将资质要求落实到采购清单
把招标文件需要的企业资料、产品型号资料和现场交付记录分栏整理，注明提交阶段。这样可以在询价时发现缺件，避免验收时才补充材料。
en: Build the procurement file
List corporate documents, model-specific evidence and site handover records separately. Assign a submission stage to each item so gaps can be identified while quotations are being prepared.

zh: 放大阅读证书原页
打开本页对应的高清画册，逐份核对证书标题、编号、签发时间和载明范围。对于图像中难以辨认的文字，可按证书标题向企业索取电子副本。
en: Read the certificate image
Open the full-size brochure spread to inspect each title, reference number, issue date and stated scope. Request an electronic copy by title if a detail is difficult to read.

zh: 采购与设备资料配套
企业证书与设备铭牌描述的是不同对象。针对拟采购的地磅，还应记录型号、最大秤量、分度值、仪表型号及所需交付文件，方便逐项比对。
en: Match documentation to the equipment

Company certificates and equipment nameplates describe different subjects. For a particular weighbridge, record the model, capacity, scale interval, indicator and required handover documents for comparison.

zh: 形成可追溯的资料包
以项目编号归档证书、确认图、设备清单和验收记录，并保留文件日期。日后更换传感器或仪表时，维护人员可据此找到原配置。
en: Keep a traceable project file

Archive certificates, approved drawings, equipment schedules and acceptance records under the project reference. Keep document dates so maintenance staff can trace the original configuration when replacing components.

zh: 从车辆和场地确定制造输入
订制汽车衡前，应确认最长车辆的轴组跨度、最大满载重量、通行方向和现场引坡空间。再用现场平面图标出排水、检修和电缆路线，作为秤台分段、安装方式与仪表位置的讨论依据。
en: Define the manufacturing inputs

Before specifying a truck scale, establish the longest axle-group span, maximum loaded vehicle weight, traffic direction and approach space. Mark drainage, service access and cable routes on the site plan to discuss deck sections, installation layout and indicator position.

zh: 把现场交接变成可核对的记录
到货时按装箱清单核对秤台分段、传感器、接线箱和仪表。安装调试时由负责人员记录空秤回零、车辆重复上秤和不同位置加载的结果，并保存接线图和最终参数，作为后续排查的基线。
en: Document commissioning

Check delivered deck sections, load cells, junction boxes and indicators against the packing list. Have the commissioning team record zero return, repeat weighings and loading at different deck positions. Keep the wiring diagram and final settings as a maintenance baseline.

zh: 售后报修需要哪些信息
空秤读数漂移、同一车辆重复称量差异和仪表无法通讯，需要不同的排查路径。联系4000-566-765时，说明设备型号、故障出现时间、是否与降雨或车辆位置相关，并提供仪表显示照片和近期维护记录。
en: Prepare a service request

An unstable empty reading, inconsistent repeat weighings and a communications fault call for different checks. When calling 4000-566-765, provide the model, time of onset, any link with rain or vehicle position, a display photograph and recent maintenance history.

zh: 在量程和台面之间做匹配
画册列出的SCS量程为20、30、50、60、80、100、120及150吨。先核对车货总重，再核对轴距、轮距和上秤姿态，确保需要计量的全部车轴能同时停留在承载台面上。
en: Match capacity and deck size

The SCS brochure lists 20, 30, 50, 60, 80, 100, 120 and 150 tonne capacities. Check gross vehicle weight, axle spacing, track width and approach direction so every axle to be weighed can stand on the live deck at once.

zh: 地上式与基坑式如何取舍
地上式需要给引坡留出长度，基坑式则要考虑坑内排水、清理和人员检修空间。场地评估时同时标出车辆转弯路线及直线上秤距离。
en: Compare pit and above-ground layouts

An above-ground deck needs room for approaches. A pit installation needs drainage, cleaning access and space for maintenance. Map turning movements and the straight approach distance when comparing layouts.

zh: 配套传感器要核对哪些参数
更换或配置传感器时，应核对额定载荷、安装尺寸、输出类型与配套仪表。记录原传感器铭牌和接线方式，方便技术人员核对兼容性并安排重新调试。
en: Specify compatible load cells

Check rated load, mounting dimensions, output type and indicator compatibility when specifying a cell. Photograph the existing nameplate and wiring arrangement to support compatibility checks and recommissioning.

zh: 称重模块的受力路径
模块把容器或设备的载荷传给传感器。选型时应说明容器自重、最大物料量、支点数量与布置，同时说明搅拌振动、连接管道和热胀冷缩情况。
en: Trace the load path
A weigh module transfers a vessel or machine load to its cell. Specify empty weight, maximum contents and support geometry, together with vibration, attached pipework and thermal movement.

zh: 将车辆识别与过磅顺序配合
读卡器或车牌识别设备用于识别车辆，摄像机记录现场，红绿灯提示车辆动作。布置时先画出停车位置和驾驶员视线，再确定识别点与提示设备的位置。
en: Coordinate identification and traffic

Card readers or plate recognition devices identify a vehicle, cameras document the scene and signals direct movement. Mark stopping positions and driver sight lines before locating identification points and signals.

zh: 为异常情况留出人工处理方式
在方案确认阶段讨论车牌识别失败、刷卡重复、车辆倒车和通讯中断时的处理流程。把允许放行的条件、人工确认人和留存记录写入现场操作要求。
en: Plan exception handling

Discuss failed plate reads, repeated card scans, reversing vehicles and communications interruptions during design. Document release conditions, who may approve exceptions and which records are retained.

zh: 仪表从现场信号接到业务记录
选择称重仪表时，先核对传感器类型和数量，再确认读数距离、安装环境及与上位系统的数据接口。若需多台设备交换数据，应明确哪台设备产生最终重量记录。
en: Connect indicators to the workflow

Match the indicator to the cell type and count, then consider viewing distance, enclosure location and the host data interface. Where several devices exchange readings, define which one creates the final weight record.

zh: 从一张磅单确定打印需求
用现有磅单样本确认毛重、皮重、净重、日期和车辆编号等字段，以及纸张宽度、打印联数和数据来源。再核对打印机接口与仪表输出是否匹配。
en: Start with a sample ticket
Use a sample ticket to agree gross, tare, net, date and vehicle identifiers. Confirm paper width, copies and field sources, then check the printer interface against the indicator output.

zh: 小地磅同时考虑搬运方式
台面需要容纳托盘及实际落点，量程应覆盖货物和容器的总重量。经常冲洗的场地还应确认台面材质、传感器和接线部件的环境适应性，以及坡道与搬运车的配合。
en: Size a floor scale for handling

Allow room for the pallet and its practical placement range. Include containers in the gross load. For washdown locations, review deck material, cell and junction protection, and ramp compatibility with handling equipment.
